page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance belonging to the Enhanced ecs.c6t family. Built on KVM hypervisor virtualization, the server is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU core. The hardware architecture contains no discrete GPU accelerators or bundled local disk storage.

Network performance for the ecs.c6t.xlarge includes a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The instance provides no complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring networking setup through cloud virtual private networks or external elastic IPs. Storage operations rely entirely on attached network block storage due to the absence of integrated NVMe or SATA local drives. The hardware profile prioritizes CPU compute density relative to memory capacity, making it a cost-efficient selection when memory requirements are modest.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio and dedicated processor allocation suit workloads requiring steady CPU capacity without high RAM demands. Primary application fits include software build nodes, CI/CD execution runners, lightweight web servers, application microservices, and background data processing tasks.
